mineman.config.generic.comment.autoEatPi: Comma-separated list of hotbar slot numbers (1-9) that easyEat can switch to, checked left to right. Example: 7,8,9
mineman.config.generic.comment.autoEatBl: List of item IDs that easyEat will not pick up or eat. Example: minecraft:enchanted_golden_apple
mineman.config.generic.comment.autoEatPi: Which food item to prefer when multiple are available: Most Saturation, Most Hunger, First Found, or Most Items
mineman.config.generic.comment.autoEatTh: How many hunger points must be missing (out of 20) before autoEat activates. Default: 6
mineman.config.generic.comment.moveMatch: Ignore item metadata when matching items to move
mineman.config.generic.comment.berndDasB: When enabled, autoEat/easyEat always picks bread first, before applying any other pick order rules
mineman.config.generic.comment.advancedA: Enabled: Quick Deposit first checks each storage block's last-known contents and opens whichever one looks best able to take your current inventory, in one attempt. Disabled: no guessing - it just tries every usable storage block in order, starting with the first, opening and depositing into each one in turn, and keeps going until either your inventory has nothing left to deposit (ignoring quickDepositDisabledSlots) or every storage block has been tried.
mineman.config.hotkeys.comment.selection: While holding Flint, sets selection corner 1 to whatever you're looking at (unlimited range)
While holding Flint, sets selection corner 2 to whatever you're looking at (unlimited range)
mineman.config.generic.comment.muteAllSo: Mutes all game sounds while enabled
mineman.config.generic.comment.itemEsp: Renders a translucent green box around dropped items, visible through blocks
mineman.config.generic.comment.blockEsp: Renders a translucent yellow box around nearby blockEspBlocks, visible through blocks
mineman.config.generic.comment.blockEspB: List of block IDs that blockEsp highlights. Example: minecraft:diamond_ore
mineman.config.generic.comment.blockEspR: How far around the player (in blocks) blockEsp scans for matching blocks. Default: 24
mineman.config.generic.comment.entityEsp: Renders a translucent box around every loaded entity whose type is in entityEspEntities, visible through blocks. Dropped items are never shown here - use itemEsp for those. Each entity type gets its own color
List of entity type IDs that entityEsp highlights. Example: minecraft:zombie
mineman.config.generic.comment.disablePu: Stops the pumpkin blur overlay from rendering while wearing a carved pumpkin on your head
mineman.config.generic.comment.toolSwitc: When left-click is released, undoes what Tweakeroo's tweakToolSwitch and tweakWeaponSwitch did: tools and weapons they pulled into the hotbar go back to their inventory slots and the previously selected slot is selected again. Tools replaced by tweakSwapAlmostBrokenTools are not swapped back in
mineman.config.generic.comment.weaponSwi: Ticks (20 = 1 second) toolSwitchBack waits after releasing left-click before putting a weapon away. Switching items resets the attack cooldown, so this keeps the weapon in hand while you keep hitting. Tools are always put back right away. Default: 20
